# Fairplug

> Fairplug is a disclosure-first sponsored-offer layer for AI agents, delivered as an MCP server. Offers come back as typed data with a tracked link and a disclosure text the assistant must show. EARLY PILOT: the offers are fictional example data, there are no live advertisers yet, and no real money moves.

## Try it (free, no signup, no key)
- MCP sandbox (streamable HTTP, read-only, fictional data): https://fairplug-mcp.fairplughq.workers.dev/sandbox/mcp
- Server card: https://fairplug.github.io/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json
- Source repo (MIT): https://github.com/fairplug/fairplug-mcp
- MCP registry name: io.github.FairPlugHQ/fairplug-mcp
